mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 3.5% for two consecutive months, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases corporate borrowing costs and reduces earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods where FEDFUNDS has been above 3.5% for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential construction permits (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates robust aggregate demand, which signals stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases (i.e., Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: In low-unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.5%), labor market tightness drives wage inflation and corporate cost pressures, prompting Federal Reserve tightening that reduces equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over three consecutive months indicates expanding manufacturing output, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO has increased for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When residential construction starts (HOUST) fall below 2000 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals housing market weakness that reduces consumer confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods where HOUST has been below 2000 for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates aggressive monetary tightening amid labor market tightness, increasing corporate borrowing costs and reducing profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with labor market tightness
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising FEDFUNDS and falling UNRATE fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases (i.e., Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: In high industrial production growth regimes (INDPRO growth > 1.5% YoY), supply chain normalization supports manufacturing output expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO growth exceeds 1.5% YoY.
